stop_rule: Stop after all sixteen final terminal controls, the literal full invoice, the existing 2551-pattern dual and semantic controls. Do not synthesize new allocations, compute new roots or promote a supplier.

Every nonempty V45 terminal-widening subset fails literal capacity; keeping only helper249 lowered overfills 1938 bins by 1998 units and requires at least 15354 whole-helper width units to leave them. An independent integer-square-root enclosure checks all 2551 dual inequalities; the complete moment of that control is at least 1.000005090277 at the exact source saving, even under fractional repacking.
